reason: Tier 2: add learned relative-position attention biases to MaskedSASRec. Bidirectional reconstruction reached 0.5800, whereas separating clean and corrupted views reduced HR@10 to 0.5475, so further view separation is unsupported by the supplied trajectory. An untested architectural hypothesis is that absolute position embeddings inadequately represent purchase recency and relative ordering; changing attention directly tests this while preserving the current supervision.

plan.model_design: Add a zero-initialized, learned signed relative-distance bias to each transformer layer's attention logits, retaining absolute position embeddings and bidirectional attention. Bucket key-minus-query offsets using exact distances near zero and logarithmically increasing buckets for longer distances, with separate parameters per attention head; this lets the network learn local purchase dependencies and longer-range associations. Implement the bias through additive attention masks while preserving padding exclusion, existing residual connections, normalization, dropout, tied item embeddings, and item_bias. Preserve MaskedSASRec constructor compatibility, forward(sequence), predict(sequence, candidates), and all existing data construction and loss logic so relative-position bias is the sole experimental change.
plan.training_evaluation: Update write_predict_script() and checkpoint metadata to instantiate the relative-position architecture and strictly load its learned bias parameters, preserving predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None). Train one fresh model per category with the existing optimizer, sampled-softmax objective, two-view supervision, seeds, epoch limit, and checkpoint selection; inference must load exactly one selected checkpoint per category. Preserve DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four categories, trial-local artifacts, and fixed validation candidates, and report actual macro HR@10 against both the 0.5475 immediate parent and 0.5800 reference. Verify validation and generated-predictor score parity after loading, print the selected checkpoints' macro-average as Final Validation Score, and leave hidden test inference to the host.
